title: Contextual Correction of Parallel Draftsfor Speculative Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2610.12570v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by using a lightweight drafter to propose multiple tokens that are subsequently verified in parallel by the target model. Recent diffusion-based drafters make this paradigm particularly attractive: deep attention-based neural backbones provide strong predictions, while drafting multiple future positions in parallel avoids the sequential cost of autoregressive generation. This parallelism, however, comes at a cost. Tokens within a draft block are predicted without access to the realized identities of preceding draft tokens, removing intra-block dependencies that would naturally be available under autoregressive generation. We introduce DCOCO (DFlash Contextual Corrector), a lightweight mechanism that restores these dependencies while preserving parallel drafting. translated_title: 推测解码中并行草稿的上下文修正
translated_abstract: 推测解码通过使用轻量级草稿模型提出多个token，再由目标模型并行验证，从而加速大语言模型的推理。近期基于扩散模型的草稿生成器使这一范式尤具吸引力：基于注意力的深度神经网络骨干能提供强大的预测能力，而并行起草多个未来位置则避免了自回归生成的串行开销。然而，这种并行性是有代价的：草稿块内的token在预测时无法获知其前面草稿token的实际内容，从而丢失了自回归生成中自然可用的块内依赖关系。我们提出DCOCO（DFlash Contextual Corrector，DFlash上下文修正器），这是一种在保持并行起草的同时恢复这些依赖关系的轻量级机制。DCOCO并不直接采纳每个位置的最高预测，而是保留多个候选token并对……
tldr: 提出轻量级机制DCOCO，通过保留并评估多个候选token进行上下文修正，在不牺牲并行起草效率的前提下恢复草稿块内的依赖关系，从而提升扩散式推测解码的草稿质量。
en_tdlr: DCOCO is a lightweight contextual corrector that restores intra-block dependencies in parallel speculative drafts by retaining and re-evaluating multiple candidate tokens, improving draft quality without sacrificing parallel drafting efficiency.
